text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pelvic_Ultrasound: Thickened endometrial stripe and left adnexal mass observed; Endometrial_Biopsy: Well-differentiated adenocarcinoma

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Adenocarcinoma with concurrent adnexal involvement. The findings of a thickened endometrial stripe on ultrasound and the definitive diagnosis of well-differentiated adenocarcinoma on the biopsy confirm the primary pathology. While the adnexal mass is present, the biopsy results establish the nature of the disease.
